RC-001.note: The app asks the xdg-desktop-portal Screenshot portal before any overlay; a denial fails with capture-permission-denied and no overlay. A portal that only exposes an interactive chooser is not yet handled.

RC-002.note: The portal owns the native consent prompt (verified on Hyprland, 2026-10-09); denial is reported once and never re-prompted.

RC-003.note: Topology change cancels with display-topology-changed. The snapshot holds identity, bounds, and scale; rotation and colour characteristics arrive with the display backend.

RC-005.note: One frameless fullscreen overlay per screen shows the frozen snapshot. Verified on a single Hyprland display; multi-display layouts are unverified.

RC-010.note: Arrow, Shift+Arrow, and Alt+Arrow steps are clamped and the precision modifier is shown in the overlay hint bar. Resize handles and size presets are not yet interactive.

RC-011.note: Click-to-snap and drag override are implemented (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/RegionCaptureTest.cpp). Native window and control discovery arrives with the overlay. The overlay badge shows physical size and origin with tabular digits on Qt 6.7+ and the native fixed font on Qt 6.4; the Ubuntu CI job checks the minimum-version app build.

RC-012.note: The compositor places exact source pixels in desktop physical order and rejects resampled sources (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/RegionCaptureTest.cpp). Real capture sources arrive with the portal backend.

RC-014.note: Frozen mode from one portal snapshot is implemented. Live mode is not offered.

RC-017.note: The last region is produced only on capture success and validated against topology (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/RegionCaptureTest.cpp). Atomic persistence arrives with settings storage.

RC-018.note: Stable codes capture-permission-denied, display-topology-changed, capture-source-failed, and last-region-invalid; failed composites return no pixels. The privacy and diagnostic retention policy applies once real pixels exist.

RC-019.note: Keyboard-only selection (Space anchors at a keyboard cursor), accessible name and instructions, bounds announcements, and a white-on-black boundary with corner handles. Screen-reader behaviour is not yet verified with Orca.

RC-024.note: Keyboard steps are announced to assistive technology through the overlay's accessible description.
